Code.name: Physical Constraints
Code.description: Tangible, environmental, and interpersonal threats to bodily safety, physical integrity, and personal security.

Code.name: Sexual Harassment & Unwanted Attention
Code.description: Catcalling, leering, persistent staring, stalking, groping, sexual comments, and invasive male pursuit.

Code.name: Infrastructure & Transit Vulnerability
Code.description: Risks associated with public transport, taxis, dark alleys, isolated bus stops, poor lighting, and locked spaces.

Code.name: Accommodation & Property Security
Code.description: Vulnerabilities in hostels, hotels, vacation rentals, door locks, ground floor rooms, and drink safety.

Code.name: Social Constraints
Code.description: Socio-cultural, patriarchal, normative, and familial restrictions placed on women's autonomous mobility.

Code.name: Patriarchal Gaze & Cultural Norms
Code.description: Conservative societal norms, dress policing, male dominance in public space, and gender discrimination.

Code.name: Familial Anxiety & Societal Judgment
Code.description: Family disapproval, paternalistic protection, fear of victim blaming, and warnings from social circles.

Code.name: Racialized & Foreign Vulnerability
Code.description: Vulnerabilities stemming from race, ethnicity, language barriers, and stereotyping of foreign women.

Code.name: Constraint Negotiation & Coping Strategies
Code.description: Proactive and reactive behavioral adaptations, micro-strategies, and tools women employ to navigate risk.

Code.name: Behavioral & Presentation Adaptation
Code.description: Altering physical appearance, simulated social ties, purposeful walking, and eye-contact management.

Code.name: Digital & Communication Tactics
Code.description: Leveraging digital tools, location tracking, fake calls, emergency numbers, and backup documentation.

Code.name: Spatial & Temporal Planning
Code.description: Daylight movement planning, curfew discipline, neighborhood vetting, and transport scheduling.

Code.name: Intuition & Situational Awareness
Code.description: Trusting gut feelings, peripheral alertness, reading atmospheric cues, and knowing when to exit situations.

Code.name: Perceived Safety
Code.description: Subjective cognitive and emotional state of feeling secure, guarded, vulnerable, or at ease in travel spaces.

Code.name: Subjective Security vs. Vulnerability
Code.description: Dynamic sense of personal safety, fluctuating between calm assurance and heightened vigilance.

Code.name: Objective vs. Perceived Risk Calibration
Code.description: Deconstructing sensationalized media reports versus the lived reality of everyday safety on the ground.

Code.name: Destination Image & Evaluation
Code.description: Consumer perception of destination safety reputation, institutional trust, and host community hospitableness.

Code.name: Destination Safety Reputation
Code.description: Public and peer perception of a country or city as women-friendly, safe, or hazardous.

Code.name: Institutional & Police Trust
Code.description: Confidence in local law enforcement, tourist police, emergency healthcare, and public governance.

Code.name: Travel Intention & Mobility Decisions
Code.description: Conative outcomes: destination choice, itinerary modifications, travel avoidance, and future solo travel intentions.

Code.name: Destination Choice & Route Avoidance
Code.description: Selecting or boycotting destinations, canceling trips, or altering routes due to safety considerations.

Code.name: Solo Continuation & Advocacy
Code.description: Commitment to future solo travel and recommending solo journeys to other women.

Code.name: Experiential Well-Being & Self-Leadership
Code.description: Psychological and transformative outcomes: self-efficacy, autonomy, empowerment, confidence, and flourishing.

Code.name: Empowerment & Self-Efficacy
Code.description: Enhanced sense of agency, pride, capability, self-reliance, and self-leadership through overcoming fear.

Code.name: Emotional Flourishing & Joy
Code.description: Deep psychological well-being, mindfulness, flow, serenity, and joy experienced during independent travel.
